settings.question: How long does the scent last?
settings.answer: Our perfumes are formulated to wear for 6 to 10 hours on skin. Longevity varies with body chemistry, skin type, and application — dry skin tends to absorb fragrance faster, so applying to moisturised skin or pulse points helps. Spraying on clothing generally extends projection.

settings.question: What are the notes listed on each perfume?
settings.answer: The notes we list are accords — blended aromatic impressions rather than single raw materials. They describe what you will smell at each stage of wear (top, heart, base), not a list of individual ingredients. This is standard practice in fine fragrance.

settings.question: I ordered before — will this bottle smell exactly the same?
settings.answer: We aim for consistency across every batch, and the character and profile of each scent remains the same. However, natural raw materials can vary slightly by harvest and origin, so there may be subtle differences between batches. These are normal in craft perfumery and do not indicate a fault.

settings.question: Can I return a perfume I have already opened?
settings.answer: For hygiene and safety reasons, we cannot accept returns on opened or used perfume. If your bottle arrived damaged or there is a genuine quality fault, please contact us within 14 days of delivery and we will make it right.

settings.question: I want to buy a gift but I am not sure which scent they would like — what do you suggest?
settings.answer: Our Discovery Set is the ideal gift for someone new to Son of Adam. It lets the recipient try each fragrance before committing to a full bottle, and includes a credit towards their first full-size purchase. It removes all the guesswork.

settings.question: What is the Discovery Set?
settings.answer: The Discovery Set contains a sample of every perfume in the current collection. It is the best way to find your scent without committing to a full bottle. Once you know your favourite, the credit included with the set goes towards your full-size purchase.
